training.loss: class-balanced binary cross entropy for BD, SD, and HH only; TOM and cymbal weights were zero

onset_metric: independent source MIDI, one-to-one 50 ms matching; thresholds selected on development only
limitations: The 11-track held set is the old preliminary BabySlakh diagnostic and has been observed by earlier feasibility work; it is not an untouched acceptance set.
BD clears the 0.80 onset threshold on this diagnostic, while SD and HH do not. BASS and grid F1 are absent, so the priority profile is not accepted.
No BASS model, grid F1, ARM latency, incremental RSS, or shipping-license claim is made.
The ADTOF port and base weight remain unresolved for shipment licensing.
interpretation: A full-backbone development-only transfer pass improves old-held BD and HH relative to the frozen head-only transfer, but leaves SD and HH below the 0.80 onset gate. SD has the largest development-to-held gap (0.149), suggesting that a future development-only validation/regularization experiment should diagnose generalization before another longer full-backbone epoch.
